reviews.title: Functional Eye Candy
reviews.comment: Building in this case wasn't easy (then again it's rarely easy for myself since I've only built PCs twice), but it's well worth it. Very attractive looking case, and I love how easily you can take panels off without the need for screws. It does require some planning on which cables will be fed into the interior into the graphics card and\or motherboard since the I\O comes out of the top of the case instead of the bottom, so be aware.
reviews.author: Beep

reviews.title: IN LOVE
reviews.comment: This is for my husbands gaming setup. It fits on a IKEA square shelf on the top, it’s too small to fit inside but it looks great on display sitting on the top.  Our old ones were also on the top but they hung over and didn’t look as aesthetically pleasing!
reviews.author: Jennifer
